TV-125138 is a globe control valve for Cold HTF Blend Valve Into Main & Standby HEX Loops.
Flow rate: 52,000 lbm/hr at normal operations and 1,040,000 lbm/hr at design conditions.
Inlet pressure: 180 psia, outlet pressure: 167.8 psia.
Temperature: 125°F, density: 64.8 lb/ft³, viscosity: 2.049 Cp.
Manufacturer: Flowserve, model: VL / std.
Body material: ASTM A-216 WCB, bonnet material: A-216 WCB.
Actuator type: Cylinder, orientation: Increase to open.
Communication protocol: HART, I/O analog signals: 4-20mA DC.
Valve Cv: 606, shutoff class: ANSI Class V.
The valve is a globe control valve for Cold HTF Blend Valve Into Main & Standby HEX Loops.
It operates at temperatures between 125°F and 560°F with a pressure range of 180-174.8 psia.
The valve has a flow coefficient Cv of 98% under design conditions.
Flowserve is the manufacturer, and the model is VL / std.
The valve features an integral arrow indicating the direction of flow.
Insulation is provided with a pipe standard of ASTM A-53.
Material certificates and leakage tests are required for commercial agreements.
It operates at a normal flow rate of 52,000 lbm/hr and design conditions of 1,040,000 lbm/hr.
The valve has an inlet pressure of 180 psia and outlet pressure of 167.8 psia.
It is manufactured by Flowserve with model VL / std.
The valve body material is ASTM A-216 WCB, and the bonnet material is also A-216 WCB.
The actuator type is Cylinder, and it has a stroke time of 50sec (Open) - 20Sec (Close).
The valve requires a leakage test for commercial agreement.
It operates in a hazardous area classified as Class 1, Division 2, Group D.
